experiment: E8 reader migration and B1 stabilisation
status: frozen before the full run; full run not approved

population.source: the 118 development questions used by E6

reader.served_model_policy: record every call; stop if more than one served-model string appears
reader.system_fingerprint_policy: record when supplied; frozen replies rather than the alias define the result

L-v1.pages: the exact pages supplied by frozen E6 V: four for 105 questions and three for 13

L-B1.contract: b1-image-v2, strict JSON schema, 800 maximum completion tokens

L-B1r.purpose: fresh repeat calls after all matched pairs; never served from the L-B1 cache

execution.unknown_usage_charge: For budget gating, an attempt without returned usage is charged at its precomputed request upper bound; observed token cost is reported separately.
execution.on_identity_change: append the reply as identity_mismatch and stop if either served model or system fingerprint changes
execution.on_api_error: append the failure and stop; a later explicit resume may retry that execution index
execution.repeat_cache_rule: L-B1r has a distinct execution index and must make a fresh call

scoring.S-v1: historical primary; score > 0 on the 102 answerable questions
scoring.S-v2: automatic protocol plus experiments/frozen/scoring_v2 blind adjudication
scoring.unsure: exclude from S-v2 point estimates and paired contrasts; report wrong/correct sensitivity

decision_rules.technical: 354 validated replies, one served model, finish_reason stop throughout, and at least 117 of 118 schema-valid L-B1 replies per replicate
decision_rules.migration_harm: L-v1 delta <= -0.05 and the cluster 95% upper bound < 0 against both frozen GPT-4o-mini anchors
decision_rules.adopt_contract_v2: schema validity >= 0.99, citation validity no more than 0.03 below L-v1, and answerable accuracy delta >= -0.05
decision_rules.unstable: more than 10 correctness flips between L-B1 and L-B1r on 102 answerable questions
decision_rules.abstention_guardrail: at least 5 correct abstentions among the 16 unanswerable questions

approval: This specification and executor do not authorize a paid call. VISUALDOC_QA_MODE=full requires separate explicit owner approval.
